correctness.rationale: The EF lemma gives necessary and sufficient rank-three signatures for vertex-transitive graphs. All Kneser parameter regimes are separated by an exhaustive union-size criterion; the constructive three-mask lemma includes the k=2,n=2k+1 boundary. The full eight representative classes are distinct, with sharp Rado and mixed thresholds. The independent Python checker passed 138 explicit small parameter cases; those computations are only corroborating evidence.

value.rationale: A natural complete classification for all finite Kneser graphs at one fixed logical resource. The sharp 2k, 3k-1 and 3k boundaries, first mixed example at 35 vertices, and first Rado-rank-three Kneser example at 15 vertices resolve structural expressivity and existential-closure questions for the full two-parameter family. These exact invariants are mathematically motivated rather than arbitrary census slices.
